title: Create: Engineering
description: Have you ever wondered because in the create mod there are engineers goggles but no suit for it? Well I did and added a custom super cool armor with it's own model and animations.
body:
# CreateEngineering

This mod adds some cool create mod features

The items have a custom recipe and can be optained in surviaval Minecraft with Create

### Dependencies:
- Create by simibubi
- Geckolib by Gecko

### ModItems
#### It could spoiler you something Spoiler Alert

<details>
<summary>Engineerssuit</summary>
I have wanted the hole time that create adds an engenieers set to complete the engenieers googles, but it didn't so I came up with my first piece of my collection the so called **Engineers Suit** I'm pretty happy with how it turned out. It has some fancy little animations and a kneed model, but the best part is the icon. I mean just look at it.

![TheEngenieersSuit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a81f4ea4e9c29518b0c048152b18a48166c50fa.png)
Sorry my english no good. I wrote engenieerssuit instead of engineerssuit and now the item ID is createengineering:engenieerssuit
</details>

Please check out my [other projects](https://modrinth.com/plugin/groupchats) too;D
